profile_text.body:
LlamaIndex is a software company focused on tooling for building AI-powered document and data workflows. Its flagship product, LlamaParse, is described on its site as an agentic OCR system designed to process complex documents containing tables, charts, and images. The company also maintains an open-source document parsing library that works with PDFs, Office documents, and images without requiring cloud services or language model tokens.

The tracked product, LlamaIndex, is categorized as a coding and developer tool and encompasses a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) framework, data connectors, indexing strategies, and enterprise RAG governance capabilities. The company describes its offering as providing schema-based, LLM-powered extraction without requiring model training, and positions it for use cases in financial services, manufacturing, and healthcare, including applications such as invoice processing, analysis of technical manuals, and handling of medical records and insurance claims.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for LlamaIndex.
